summary.text: Kevin Gulbranson is the Libertarian candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 61, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which Republican Scott Shamblin and incumbent Democrat Eliza Hamrick also appear on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Gulbranson has previously run as a Libertarian for the Colorado House, appearing on the general election ballot for District 56 in 2018 and 2020 and for District 61 in 2022.
